home.intro: On the Dorpsplein in Zandvoort, two minutes from the beach. Open every day from {open} to {close}.
home.about.title: The club on the square
home.about.text: Yanks has been on the village square for decades. Besides the coffeeshop there is a bar, pool tables, game tables and big screens, all in a Native American interior. You order at your table with a QR code, and the prices are on one big board.
home.terrace.title: The terrace
home.terrace.text: A big terrace with wooden tables and benches, a roof that opens when the weather is good and heaters for the evening.
home.terrace.alt: The Yanks terrace: carved wooden benches and tables under a retractable roof.
home.late.title: Open late
home.late.text: Every day until {close}. From {dineInUntil} it is takeaway only.
home.beach.title: Two minutes from the beach
home.beach.text: The North Sea beach is a two-minute walk from the Dorpsplein. From Amsterdam Centraal the train takes about half an hour.
home.menu.text: Coffee, tea, soft drinks and something to eat, from breakfast to the last hour.
home.shop.text: Souvenirs from a real place on the square. Two of them are numbered.
